title: Graphic & Web Designer
description:
**We’re Hiring – Web & Graphic Designer**

**Location:** Tirupur, Tamil Nadu  
**Work Mode:** Full-Time | Work From Office  
**Company:** GeoWeb – D2C Branding & Shopify Agency

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Design website banners, layouts, and landing pages.
* Create social media creatives and ad graphics.
* Design product mockups and e-commerce visuals.
* Develop premium graphics for beauty, wellness, and lifestyle brands.
* Work closely with Shopify developers and marketing teams.

**Skills Required:**

* Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva & Figma.
* Strong understanding of UI/UX and e-commerce design.
* Knowledge of AI design tools is an advantage.
* Creative mindset with strong visual aesthetics.

**Experience:** 1–3 years preferred  
**Salary:** Based on skills and experience. **Apply Now:** Share your resume and design portfolio.

Pay: ₹14,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
